text:
mila (design): throwing up a small riff: move schema linter out of the page banner and into a tiny inline "validation pin" on each function row. keeps editor tidy and surfaces bad defs.
kevin (devex): sounds good. do we show count on the pin? list-level pin would be quick to scan.
mila (design): yes, small badge like "! 1". click expands an accordion under the row with short messages + jump-to-field links.
jordan (backend): ok. implementation note: re-run linter on expand but debounce 300ms and cache results for 20s.
tess (a11y): panel should be role=region aria-label="function validation" and use aria-live=polite when new errors arrive. keyboard: Enter toggles, Arrow nav inside.
rachel (product): parallel idea: compact run-history card showing tool name, one-line summary, and a tiny cost chip (tokens/$). expand loads full structured output.
kevin (devex): add streaming flag so UI shows a live dot. keep summary <= 200 chars, lazy-load payload on expand.
jordan (backend): agreed. data contract: summaryText, pointerId, costApprox, isStreaming, ts. will draft RFC.
ci-cd-bot: mila pushed preview: https://preview.redwood/playground/validation-pin
mila (design): action items: kevin RFC for keyboard + focus, jordan debounce + pointer, tess accessibility checklist, rachel metrics gate for beta. thanks!
